name: inbox-op-action
description: Archive, mark read, mute a thread, dismiss, or write a draft reply on an inbox item when a trigger fires. Every operation is reversible, so an auto-executed one always keeps a one-click undo. A native action, no shell-out.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Operation
x-meta.help: What to do to the item. Archive, mark read and mute are the reversible everyday ones; dismiss removes it from the surface; reply_draft writes a draft and never sends.

x-meta.label: Inbox Item
x-meta.help: The inbox item id to operate on. Supports $<payload-key> so a trigger can pass the item that fired it.

x-meta.label: Draft Reply
x-meta.help: Body to write into the item's draft field. Only used by reply_draft — it is never sent.
